blocks.text:
Pull up close, I'll show you how I did it
Wasn't magic, wasn't slick — just a cheap little trick
Held a lantern at my hip, told you it was wicked
Made the wall behind me grow and gave you all a kick

I held the flashlight at hip height
Made a giant of the night
Worked the angle, worked the light
Made the shadow fit your fright
Now the lights come up bright
And the giant slipped from sight

Every year a brand new threat, every year you came
Reds and germs and robots and the panic of the frame
Lantern at my hip, big blank wall, knew the angle, knew the game
Different giant every show — and you bought it all the same

I held the flashlight at hip height
Made a giant of the night
Worked the angle, worked the light
Made the shadow fit your fright
Now the lights have come up bright
And the giant's slipped from sight
lone piano, single isolated voice, spoken-sung confession, no harmonies

Look. That was the whole trick.
A lantern. A wall. A hand at my hip.
That's all the giant ever was.
That's all I ever was.
slower, chastened, voice cracking, single voice only, no backing vocals

Made a giant of the night
Worked the angle, worked the light
Made the shadow fit your fright
Now the lights have come up bright
And the giant's slipped from sight

notebook.style: high-energy ragged street-circus cabaret, MC confessional with vaudeville barker bones, mismatched junkyard instrumentation — tuba oompah, banjo, washboard, suitcase kick, hammered metal, beat-up piano, Single isolated lead vocal throughout, one voice only — no backing vocals, no harmonies, no choir, no vocal doubling, Conversational speak-sing, intimate and rueful, among the audience not above them, Full junk-percussion band on verses and chorus, drops to lone piano for bridge confession, returns chastened for final chorus
